name: Personal Website
desc: A personal website built with React + Vite + TypeScript + Supabase, documenting life, reading, projects, and dreams.

name: Super Mario
desc: A recreation of the original 1985 Super Mario, built in C++ using OOP techniques.

name: ABSA Pipeline: CodePulse User Feedback Sentiment Analysis
desc: Extracts sentiment quadruplets from user feedback using both an Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis pipeline and an LLM, compares their performance, and visualizes the results as word clouds.

name: CodePulse: Data Structures & Algorithms Visualization Learning Platform
desc: An algorithm teaching platform combining interactive visualization and code execution tracing. Pre/post-test research showed it significantly boosted learners' confidence, while also revealing a gap between interface effectiveness and measurable learning outcomes.

name: Should You Steal on Two Outs? A Base-Running Decision Guide for CPBL Coaches
desc: Analyzes the break-even steal threshold in CPBL games with two outs and a runner on first only, accounting for the fact that a failed steal holds the batter over to the next inning.
